purpose: Controlled account-level cutover of the existing zhongshu Feishu consumer, with immediate rollback on any required gate failure.
allowed_operations: fresh sanitized production baseline and preflight collection
account-scoped OpenClaw RPC channels.stop/channels.start for feishu/zhongshu only after all live prechecks pass
Project Gateway start/stop only after zero-consumer proof or during mandatory rollback
one authorized R0-R5 message/file/card sequence in the existing zhongshu bot and existing VideoFactory group
immediate rollback and sanitized execution evidence
prohibited_actions: modify OpenClaw core source, Agent, Binding, Cron, OAuth, model, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
create a second consumer, Feishu App, Bot, or group
write credentials to command lines, logs, reports, or source
delete tasks, history, sessions, or user files
commit, push, tag, P0_READY, P1, or P0 acceptance gate
hard_gates: single zhongshu consumer at all times except a proven zero-consumer handoff window
fresh Core ownership and current consumer count must be proven before stop
zero consumer must be proven before Project Gateway start
any required gate failure triggers immediate stop or rollback
no production action if consumer state is unknown
secrets: Only redacted identifiers, hashes, counts, timestamps, statuses, and one-way fingerprints may be persisted.
